name: Tide Clock
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Ambient day on a small coast: tide, lighthouse, keeper
description: Tide Clock plays an ambient piece that follows the time of day. Near-silent low drones before dawn, brighter and busier through the morning, full at midday, warm in the evening, dark and slow at night. A small coast on the screen keeps time with it: the sky, the sun and moon, two tides a day, boats, gulls, weather, and a lighthouse keeper who lights the lamp at dusk, worries in storms and keeps a log of the days. Clock mode follows the real time (set it at power-on); Cycle mode runs a whole day every few hours. Thirteen presets recolour the sound.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
